description: This file declares the PlaybackService class, which implements the IPlaybackService interface. It manages media playback, WebAudio, shared memory buffers, and media pipeline services within the Rialto server component. The class provides methods to control playback state, configure maximum concurrent playbacks and WebAudio players, and access shared resources.
